label: Listening 1 — When's your birthday?
lines: Listening one. When's your birthday? Write the dates.
It's on the third of March.
My birthday is on the twenty-first of June.
Mine is on the twelfth of October.
It's on the thirtieth of August.
Mine is easy — it's on the first of January!

label: Listening 2 — What time is it?
lines: Listening two. What time is it? Circle the right time.
The train to London leaves at quarter past seven.
Hurry up! The film starts at half past eight.
Excuse me, when does the shop close? — At nine o'clock.
Our English lesson is at quarter to eleven.
The bus comes at twenty to five.

label: Listening 3 — Plans for the weekend
lines: Listening three. Jack and Lily plan a weekend. Listen and complete.
Hi, Lily! Let's go to the cinema on Saturday.
Let's meet at half past ten.
And when does the film finish?
Perfect. Oh, and my birthday party is on the twentieth of May. Can you come?
